notes: 5 proof concepts under the proposed new rules (English only, Poppins, realistic, filtered inspo + $10k statics + scripts).

concepts.angle: Dear Nurses winning layout + struck-through pain words next to each benefit (Armadilo 'Dear Chefs' pattern)
concepts.based_on: Winner: Dear Nurses callouts ($229k+, 4.34 ROAS), 12-hour shift list ($858k). Inspiration: Armadilo 'Dear Chefs, survive the double pain free' (11 days, strikethrough pain vs benefit). Script: B6 'no more cramped toes or aching heels by hour eight'
concepts.headline: Dear Nurses, survive 12 hours.
concepts.prompt: Plain clean white background, flat soft studio light. Headline top left in two lines: "Dear Nurses," (Poppins regular) and "survive 12 hours." (Poppins ExtraBold). One big hero shoe in the center, the black-purple shoe from the reference at three-quarter side angle, about 50% of the frame, soft natural shadow. Four thin hand-drawn black curved arrows to four labels, each label shows a small grey struck-through pain word above a bold benefit: "Aching heels" struck through / "Cushioned heel"; "Cramped toes" struck through / "Wide toe box"; "Wet floors" struck through / "Slip-resistant grip"; "Tying laces" struck through / "No-tie laces". Along the bottom one plain line: "40% OFF"  "FREE SHIPPING"  "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE". All on-image text is set in Poppins (geometric sans): Poppins ExtraBold for headlines, Poppins SemiBold for labels, exactly the lettering of a clean ecommerce ad, never a script or novelty font. Must look like a genuine photograph or screenshot, NOT AI: natural uneven lighting, visible fabric and skin texture, slight lens softness and grain, imperfect framing, no plastic HDR glow, no symmetrical perfection. All supporting text is large and bold (every line at least 1/25 of the canvas height, max 5 words per label), high contrast. Text colors are only black, deep navy or white. The shoe keeps its true natural proportions, never compressed, flattened or tiny. No other text, no logos, no extra badges, no buttons.

concepts.headline: 250 lbs. 14 miles. Zero heel pain.
concepts.prompt: Full-bleed candid phone photo, shot from a low angle slightly in front, of a smiling plus-size woman in her 50s in black leggings and a casual top walking briskly mid-stride down a sunny theme-park street, one foot forward and one foot pushing off, natural arm swing, castle softly blurred behind in warm afternoon light, crowd out of focus. Frame her from the thighs down so her legs and the all-black shoe from the reference photo fill the lower 60% of the image: a pair, large, sharp, true proportions, both shoes clearly visible in a natural walking stance (not planted side by side). Across the top third over the bright sky, one huge heavy Poppins ExtraBold headline in black, three stacked lines filling the full width: "250 LBS." then "14 MILES." then "ZERO HEEL PAIN." The words "14 MILES." sit on a solid purple (#7A2FE0) bar with white text. A small line in black Poppins SemiBold on two lines in the open sky area at the left only, never over her body or clothing: "My doctor said I'd never" / "walk normally again." Two thin hand-drawn black arrows to the shoe with labels in Poppins SemiBold (no script font): "Cushioned heel", "Wide toe box". All on-image text is set in Poppins, never a script or handwritten font. Must look like a genuine photograph, NOT AI: natural uneven light, visible fabric and skin texture, slight grain, imperfect framing. concepts.angle: Disney day step-count direct response with the HSA/FSA 30% savings hook (HSA benchmark) in a real park photo (v2: one full-bleed photo, headline set directly on the sky so it flows into the scene)
concepts.based_on: Winner: HSA/FSA 'Did you know?' static; TOFV1_KW1 Disney plus-size (4.39 ROAS); Kyro 373 'sitting on a bench' travel pain. Inspiration: VIVAIA '10,000 steps and beyond' lifestyle (16 days)
concepts.headline: A Disney day is 20,000 steps.
concepts.prompt: ONE continuous full-bleed candid phone photo filling the entire frame edge to edge, no white band, no panel, no box behind the text. Low-angle shot of a woman walking mid-stride on a sunny theme-park street, her legs and the red-burgundy shoe from the reference photo (a pair, large, sharp, true proportions, natural walking stance, about 45% of the frame) in the lower half; her body rises into the middle of the frame and the cinematic castle sits softly blurred in the right background, with a large area of open blue sky across the top of the whole image. The headline is set directly on that sky, as if part of the scene, with no background shape: huge heavy Poppins ExtraBold in black, two lines filling the width: "A Disney day is" and "20,000 steps." Her raised leg and the castle spire may overlap or tuck behind the letters slightly so type and photo interlock. Right under it in white Poppins SemiBold with a very soft natural shadow: "Is your shoe ready?". Two thin black arrows to the shoe with Poppins labels "Cushioned heel" and "Room to swell". At the bottom two solid white rounded pills with black bold text: "HSA/FSA ELIGIBLE" and "UP TO 30% SAVINGS", and one plain white line under them: "FREE SHIPPING · 30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE". All on-image text is set in Poppins, never a script or handwritten font, including the arrow labels. Must look like a genuine photograph, NOT AI: natural uneven light, visible fabric and skin texture, slight grain, imperfect framing. All supporting text is large and bold (every line at least 1/25 of the canvas height, max 5 words per label), high contrast. Text colors are only black, deep navy or white. The shoe keeps its true natural proportions, never compressed, flattened or tiny. No other text, no logos, no badges, no buttons.
